en: A song, a psalm, of the sons of Korach.

he: גָּ֘ד֤וֹל יְהֹוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד בְּעִ֥יר אֱ֝לֹהֵ֗ינוּ הַר־קׇדְשֽׁוֹ׃
en: Great is Havayah and highly praised, in the city of our Elokim, His holy mountain.

he: יְפֵ֥ה נוֹף֮ מְשׂ֢וֹשׂ כׇּל־הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ הַר־צִ֭יּוֹן יַרְכְּתֵ֣י צָפ֑וֹן קִ֝רְיַ֗ת מֶ֣לֶךְ רָֽב׃
en: Beautiful of elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Tzion, the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
Elokim is in her palaces; He is known as a stronghold.
For behold, the kings gathered; they passed together.

he: הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ כֵּ֣ן תָּמָ֑הוּ נִבְהֲל֥וּ נֶחְפָּֽזוּ׃
en: They saw — so they marveled; they were terrified, they hastened away.
Trembling seized them there — pangs like a woman in labor.
With an east wind You shatter the ships of Tarshish.

he: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁמַ֨עְנוּ ׀ כֵּ֤ן רָאִ֗ינוּ בְּעִיר־יְהֹוָ֣ה צְ֭בָאוֹת בְּעִ֣יר אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ אֱלֹ֘הִ֤ים יְכוֹנְנֶ֖הָ עַד־עוֹלָ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
en: As we heard, so we saw, in the city of Havayah Tzevaot, in the city of our Elokim: Elokim shall establish her forever. Selah.
We have envisioned, Elokim, Your kindness, in the midst of Your heichal.

he: כְּשִׁמְךָ֤ אֱלֹהִ֗ים כֵּ֣ן תְּ֭הִלָּתְךָ עַל־קַצְוֵי־אֶ֑רֶץ צֶ֝֗דֶק מָלְאָ֥ה יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
en: Like Your name, Elokim, so is Your praise, to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.

he: יִשְׂמַ֤ח ׀ הַר־צִיּ֗וֹן תָּ֭גֵלְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה לְ֝מַ֗עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ׃
en: Mount Tzion rejoices; the daughters of Yehudah exult, because of Your judgments.
Go around Tzion and encircle her; count her towers.

he: שִׁ֤יתוּ לִבְּכֶ֨ם ׀ לְֽחֵילָ֗הֿ פַּסְּג֥וּ אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ לְמַ֥עַן תְּ֝סַפְּר֗וּ לְד֣וֹר אַחֲרֽוֹן׃
en: Set your heart to her rampart; go through her palaces — so that you may tell the last generation.

he: כִּ֤י זֶ֨ה ׀ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֱ֭לֹהֵינוּ עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד ה֖וּא יְנַהֲגֵ֣נוּ עַל־מֽוּת׃ {פ}
en: For this is Elokim, our Elokim forever and ever; He shall lead us beyond death.
